title: V3 亏损 TOP30 卖出原因审计
primary_question: V3 股票腿亏损 TOP30 主要来自突破失败止损，还是大盘风向变化触发的风险退出；卖出后表现是否证明卖出合理？
primary_variable: read-only realized-loss attribution by exit reason, market index, SW L1 industry index, and post-sell returns
fixed_assumptions: stock_alpha_core closed trades only; ETF sleeve excluded
no runtime, NAV, signal, pool, execution, ranking, or exit-rule changes
closed trades reconstructed with FIFO matched cashflows; unmatched partial sell lots reported separately

evidence.note: human report for V3 stock-leg loss TOP30 exit reason audit
machine summary with cause buckets, industry summary, and sell judgment summary
per-trade loss TOP30 detail with market, industry, and post-sell returns

key_findings: TOP30 loss is primarily risk-off forced exits: 20/30 trades, CNY 1.551M loss, 59.0% of TOP30 loss.
Breakout failure/stop exits are the secondary source: 10/30 trades, CNY 1.080M loss, 41.0% of TOP30 loss.
Risk-off exits averaged -17.13% realized return with same-holding-window SSE -1.75% and SW L1 industry -6.23%.
Stop/failure exits averaged -21.84% realized return; same-holding-window SSE was +0.32%, pointing more to single-name/industry failure than broad market collapse.
Post-sell evidence is mixed: 18/30 continued weak or limited impact, 11/30 rebounded clearly, and 1/30 was conservative with later repair.

decision.reason: The evidence supports continuing with theme-aware risk-off diagnostics before changing sell rules; do not simply loosen RISK_OFF_EXIT.

next_actions: Design a shadow layer that separates broad-market weak, industry weak, and held-theme weak at risk-off sell dates.
For whipsaw cases, test whether theme strength would have justified delaying forced exit.
For stop/failure cases, audit entry chase level, breakout quality, and post-entry confirmation discipline.
